reviewer: Claude (visual inspection of the closeup sheet and measurement)
notes: v1 is the existing in-game shrubs from build_veg2.py / build_veg3.py.

defects.text: Bare shrubs are broom-like: about nine straight rods fan out of one point, almost no forking, a few strays reach past 1.7 m. Reads as sticks, not a thorny hedgerow shrub. bare_a is 1.77 m high against 1.1-1.6.
defects.fix: Rebuild with sinuous stems, two levels of forks and fine tip twigs; height 1.25-1.4 m.

defects.text: Leafy shrubs: leaf cards line each straight stem like feathers and the stems fan from one point, so they read as laurel or fern fronds, not a rounded hedgerow shrub. Cards are 0.6-0.9 m long (leaf size should be 6-10 cm). leafy_a is 2.7 m wide for 1.8 m tall.
defects.fix: Branching skeleton with small leaf cards on the twigs, in 3D; width about 1.2-1.5 m.

defects.text: 6,395 triangles for four pieces (bare_a alone 2,130) for thin rods.
